# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 15 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 7 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Size — 6 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #17181b);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #17181b;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #17181b | #ffffff | Tarjetas de ejercicio, filas, listas y hojas inferiores. |
| `--surface-raised` | #212328 | #ffffff | Lo que va encima de surface: campos numéricos, barra de descanso, menús. En claro se separa con shadow-sm. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #f3f1ed);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #141518);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f3f1ed;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #f3f1ed | #141518 | Texto principal, pesos y reps. Sobre bg, surface, surface-raised y brasa-soft. |
| `--ink-muted` | #a8acb3 | #50545b | Texto secundario: cabeceras de tabla, columna Anterior, metadatos. 4.5:1 o más en todas las superficies. |
| `--ink-subtle` | #8a8f98 | #6a6e76 | Placeholders y valores objetivo de la rutina. 4.5:1 sobre bg y surface; en oscuro 4.8:1 sobre surface-raised. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--bg, #0e0f11);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--bg, #f4f3f0);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #0e0f11;
```

### Tokens (15)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg` | #0e0f11 | #f4f3f0 | Fondo de pantalla. Todo el texto de ink, ink-muted e ink-subtle cumple 4.5:1 sobre él. |
| `--line` | #2d3036 | #e2e0db | Divisores y bordes decorativos. Nunca como único borde de un control. |
| `--line-strong` | #6a6f78 | #8c8881 | Borde de controles (campos, botón secundario, casilla sin marcar): 3:1 sobre surface y surface-raised en ambos temas. |
| `--brasa` | #ff6b1f | #ea580c | El color de Ferro. Relleno del botón primario, casilla de serie hecha, progreso del descanso. Una acción primaria por pantalla. Texto encima: on-brasa. |
| `--brasa-pressed` | #e85a12 | #d94f0a | Estado pulsado de lo que usa brasa. on-brasa encima sigue en 4.6:1 o más. |
| `--brasa-text` | #ff6b1f | #b8440a | Texto e iconos naranjas sobre bg, surface y brasa-soft: enlaces, récords, botón fantasma. En claro es más oscuro que brasa para llegar a 4.5:1. |
| `--brasa-soft` | #3a1e10 | #fde6d6 | Fondo de la fila de serie completada, del aviso de récord y del chip seleccionado. Texto encima: ink o brasa-text. |
| `--iron` | #1c1e22 | #1c1e22 | La placa del símbolo y el fondo del icono de app. Igual en los dos temas. Solo para la marca, no para UI. |
| `--success` | #3dd68c | #15803d | Confirmaciones (copia exportada, guardado). Texto sobre bg y surface. |
| `--warning` | #f2b53a | #9a5b06 | Avisos no bloqueantes (copia de seguridad antigua, series sin marcar). |
| `--danger` | #ff8f99 | #c81e3a | Errores y acciones destructivas. Siempre con icono o texto: en oscuro es más claro que brasa, pero su tono es cercano. |
| `--set-warmup` | #6ea8ff | #2058d8 | Letra W de serie de calentamiento. Azul frío frente al naranja: el metal aún no está caliente. |
| `--set-failure` | #ff8f99 | #c81e3a | Letra F de serie al fallo. |
| `--set-drop` | #b794f6 | #7a3be0 | Letra D de drop set. |
| `--focus` | #ff6b1f | #b8440a | Anillo de foco de teclado y de lector de pantalla: 2px, separado 2px del control. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 40px/40px "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: 0.01em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 40px / 40px, letter-spacing 0.01em | 700 | `display` | Título grande de pantalla y resumen de entreno, en mayúsculas. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 28px / 32px | 700 | `display` | Cabecera de pantalla y nombre de rutina. |
| `number-xl` | `.number-xl`, `--text-number-xl` | 48px / 48px | 600 | `display` | Temporizador de descanso, totales del resumen. Cifras tabulares. |
| `number` | `.number`, `--text-number` | 20px / 24px | 600 | `display` | Peso y reps en la tabla de series. Cifras tabulares. |
| `heading` | `.heading`, `--text-heading` | 18px / 24px | 600 | `sans` | Nombre de ejercicio en la tarjeta, títulos de sección. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Texto corrido, notas, instrucciones. |
| `body-strong` | `.body-strong`, `--text-body-strong` | 16px / 24px | 600 | `sans` | Botones y elementos de lista. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Metadatos, ayudas bajo campos. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 12px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.08em | 600 | `sans` | Cabeceras de tabla y etiquetas, en mayúsculas, en ink-muted. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Hueco entre icono y texto. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Hueco entre columnas de la tabla de series y entre chips. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Relleno interno de campos y tarjetas compactas. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Margen lateral de pantalla y relleno de tarjetas. |
| `--space-5` | 24px | Separación entre tarjetas de ejercicio. |
| `--space-6` | 32px | Separación entre secciones. |
| `--space-7` | 48px | Aire alrededor de estados vacíos y del resumen. |

## Shadow

### Use

```css

/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-sm), so that a change to tokens.css, or a change of theme, reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-sm` | none · light: 0 1px 2px rgba(20, 21, 24, 0.08), 0 0 0 1px rgba(20, 21, 24, 0.04) | Tarjetas en claro. En oscuro la elevación la marca el escalón de superficie. |
| `--shadow-lg` | 0 -8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) · light: 0 -8px 24px rgba(20, 21, 24, 0.12) | Hojas inferiores y barra de descanso. |
